name: The Aomori Protocol
description: A Vault-Tec parallel project ran in northern Japan under the designation Aomori Protocol. Tanaka-san has located the vault entrance near old Aomori. The electronics inside would be worth more than a year's trading — but the vault appears to still be sealed.

stages.name: Travel North to Aomori
stages.description: Leave the Tokyo ruins and head north through the irradiated countryside to the Aomori region. Tanaka-san warns the road is contested by territorial survivor clans.

stages.name: Locate the Sealed Vault Entrance
stages.description: Search the mountainside above old Aomori for the Vault-Tec installation entrance. Tanaka-san's map coordinates are approximate — the entrance was deliberately disguised.

stages.name: Find an Alternative Entry Point
stages.description: The main door is magnetically sealed and non-responsive. Explore the surrounding mountainside for a secondary access shaft or maintenance tunnel.
